Bounded numerical examples are not used for the infinite claim.

value.rationale: A natural nonlinear cross-sublattice connected correlation has an all-order finite-activity sign staircase with exactly r-1 reversals in one imbalance direction, a parity-controlled balanced case, and a precise fold/tangency classification in the other. A genuinely reentrant four-site connected response occurs on five vertices K3,2 at exact algebraic thresholds; the statement goes beyond pairwise exclusion, supplies all parameter boundaries, and makes no bulk transition claim. The known partition polynomial and Eulerian lemma make the proof short but do not make the distinct marked-cumulant response classification a mere renaming or arbitrary enumeration.
